newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South Sea Dev in US$62 mln property deal.
newsitem.headline: South Sea Dev in US$62 mln property deal.

text.p: South Sea Development Co Ltd said it has agreed to buy a residential tower in Bejing from third party Beijing Jing Wai House and Land Estate Development Co Ltd for US$61.94 million.
The company said the property comprises the entire Tower C of Nation Wealth Plaza at the Chaoyang District in Beijing.
The plaza is a residential and commercial complex currently under development by Jing Wai. The development is expected to be completed on January 31, 1998, it said.

"The group believes that investment in premium residential properties in Beijing, which are supported by strong demand from the expatriate population in the capital, will provide the company with a steady sources of income and have appreciation prospects," South Sea said in the statement.
